suggested_change: Establish explicit handling rule: When recent call data is corrupted/unintelligible, evaluator must either (a) mark that call unscoreable and evaluate only against prior cumulative state with explicit notation, or (b) lower confidence thresholds. Separate champion scoring from evidence discovery: A 4/10 should explicitly state whether it reflects 'insufficient evidence gathered' vs 'evidence contradicts champion criteria.' Vague verb rule (follow-up) should specify it applies only to primary next steps, not secondary parallel actions. Accept that some criteria cannot be fully evaluated on corrupted data rather than creating conflicting failure modes.
